acceptance: Release readiness, source-bound evidence, distribution, state consistency, security, lockfile, Japanese capability, and strict quality checks pass for the exact merged v0.5.63 candidate; any provider failure remains an explicit publication block.

A same-SHA release rehearsal succeeds before publication, and provider release tag, source commit, metadata commit, archive, digests, SBOM, provenance, and tagged Quick Install are mutually consistent.
The archived Outcome and Human Benefit Report use English, contain all required human-summary sections, bind factual claims to evidenceRefs, and mark unsupported benefits as inference.
Post-closure checks report the WI-24 branch and remote branch removed, main synchronized with origin/main, and no unrelated user-owned worktree or dirty path was deleted.
guidelines: Every factual report claim must cite evidenceRefs; unsupported benefit language is inference only.
Do not use self-praise or unquantified performance or quality claims.
Historical archive files are immutable and may only be read and referenced.
Release publication is fail-closed on missing, stale, mismatched, or provider-unverified evidence.
The human handoff is direct, clear, and emitted in the conversation language (English for this Work Item).

intent.problem: The corrected Outcome evidence adapter is merged after v0.5.62, while the repository has a prepared v0.5.63 candidate. The final release must publish only the exact verified merged source and communicate the residual evidence limits without rewriting immutable history.
constraints: Start from the latest origin/main and use the repository release workflow; a failed or mismatched rehearsal blocks publication.
Do not rewrite historical archives, move immutable tags, claim unsupported performance or Outcome delivery, or remove unrelated user work.
Keep publication and branch/worktree cleanup inside the canonical PR, hosted-check, merge, and ai-close-work-item lifecycle.
intent.rationale: A release is trustworthy only when the immutable provider identity, repository projections, human Outcome, and final cleanup state are all evidence-bound.
